title: 第1章 全力以赴才是对捞女的最大尊重第2章 无坚不摧无物不破
slug: 人在镇魔司红词加身只杀不渡
lines: “陆渊，你一个大男人怎能如此斤斤计较？”
“我只是要你把直升名额让给我弟弟，怎么弄得好像我占你便宜一样？”
屋内，林嫚儿一袭轻纱罗裙，温润的眸子中满是委屈。
陆渊看着眼前的少女，神情一阵恍惚，两股记忆在脑海中逐渐交叠。
大乾王朝，妖魔乱世，邪祟丛生。
前身是云安县一小卒，幼年丧母，父亲是县衙里的差役。
七岁那年，一只蝠妖杀入县城，父亲为了保护城中百姓，被活生生吸成了一具干尸。
后来镇魔司来人，斩了那妖，收了尸骸，此事便告一段落。
县太爷看他孤苦，又念他父亲是衙门里的老人，便让他在十五岁时子承父业，在县衙做了个站堂的皂吏。
这一站，就是五年。
五年下来，他对镇魔司是愈发神往。
在县衙当差，月俸只有二两银子。
可若能被选入镇魔司，至少都是五两银子打底。
镇魔司衙役，穿的是刀剑难伤的墨黑锦袍，修的是斩妖除魔的杀生法，腰间那把横刀更是普通人一辈子也摸不到的法器。
走在县城街上，来往的商贩会主动打招呼，就连街边吃碗素面，摊主也会多加二两肉沫。
畏惧是一方面，更重要的是，镇魔司真能救命。
妖魔作祟，他们是真敢杀。
就算受伤也有专门的医房，用的更是掺了灵药的膏子。
即便是被妖魔杀死，家属也能领一百两抚恤银。
一百两啊！
抵得上普通人家好几年的吃穿用度了！
放在以前，前身根本不敢想这些。
毕竟他资质平庸，能在这妖魔乱世混口饭吃就不错了。
可今年开春，镇魔司在各州县选拔新血，又加了一条新规。
凡忠烈之后，可免去选拔直升镇魔司。
前身的父亲在县衙当差，被妖魔所杀，这直升名额自然是有他一份。
消息传开，林嫚儿第一个登门，但并不是来道贺。
“陆渊，你能不能把镇魔司的直升名额......让给林辰？”
“你知道的，我弟弟天赋极佳，若他能进入镇魔司，将来一定会出人头地！”
陆渊不语，神情中的恍惚逐渐清明。
他看向眼前的少女，鹅蛋脸，一双杏眼含着水光，一看就是个美人坯子。
这模样，难怪能把前身吊成翘嘴。
五年！
content_en:
"Lu Yuan, how can a grown man like you be so fussy?"
"I just want you to give up your direct promotion spot to my brother. Why do you make it look like I'm taking advantage of you?"
Inside the house, Lin Man'er was wearing a light gauze skirt, her warm eyes full of grievances.
Lu Yuan looked at the girl in front of him, his expression was in a trance, and the two memories gradually overlapped in his mind.
During the Daqian Dynasty, the world was filled with demons and evil spirits.
His predecessor was a soldier in Yun'an County. His mother died when he was young, and his father was a servant in the county government.
When he was seven years old, a bat demon entered the county town. In order to protect the people in the city, his father was sucked alive and turned into a mummy.
Later, someone from the Demon Suppression Department came, killed the demon and collected the body, and the matter came to an end.
The county magistrate saw that he was lonely and thought that his father was an old man in the government office, so he asked him to inherit his father's business when he was fifteen years old and work as a clerk in the county government office.
This stop lasts for five years.
Over the past five years, he has become increasingly fascinated by the Demon Suppression Division.
Working as an errand in the county government, his monthly salary was only two taels of silver.
But if you can be selected into the Demon Suppressing Division, you will have at least five taels of silver as a foundation.
The Yamen of the Demon Suppression Department wears a jet-black brocade robe that is hard to be damaged by swords. He practices the killing method of slaying demons and destroying demons. The horizontal sword on his waist is a magic weapon that ordinary people will never be able to touch.
When walking on the streets of the county town, vendors will greet each other proactively. Even when eating a bowl of plain noodles on the street, the stall owner will add an extra two ounces of minced meat.
Fear is one thing, but more importantly, the Demon Suppressor can really save lives.
Demons are causing trouble, and they really dare to kill them.
Even if you are injured, there is a special medical room, and the ointment mixed with elixir is used.
Even if he is killed by a demon, his family members can receive one hundred taels of silver as a pension.
One hundred taels!
It is equivalent to the food and clothing expenses of an ordinary family for several years!
In the past, my predecessor would never have dared to think about this.
After all, he has mediocre qualifications, so it would be great if he could make a living in this troubled world.
But in the spring of this year, the Demon-Suppressing Division selected new blood from various states and counties and added a new rule.
After becoming a loyal warrior, you can be directly promoted to the Demon Suppression Division without the need for selection.
My predecessor's father was an errand in the county government and was killed by a demon. Naturally, he had a share of the direct promotion quota.
When the news spread, Lin Man'er was the first to visit, but not to congratulate her.
"Lu Yuan, can you give up the direct promotion spot to the Demon Suppression Division to Lin Chen?"
"You know, my brother is extremely talented. If he can enter the Demon Suppression Division, he will definitely be successful in the future!"
Lu Yuan remained silent, the trance in his expression gradually clearing up.
He looked at the girl in front of him. She had an oval face and a pair of almond-shaped eyes. She looked like a beauty at first glance.
With this look, it’s no wonder that she can make her lips curl up in front of her body.
Five years!
